description: This PHP file defines the EmergencyContact class within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It extends ListableDisplayField and provides specific implementations for getting DTO class name, entity aliases, and fields for emergency contact information in reports.

classes.name: EmergencyContact
classes.description: Represents a display field for emergency contact information in reports, extending the ListableDisplayField base class.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object associated with this display field, specifically Dto\EmergencyContact.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in query construction, here it returns ['emergencyContact'].

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields that this display field depends on, here ['employee.empNumber'].
